Spike is occasionally referred to as Butch or Killer.
Spike is a stern but occasionally dumb American bulldog.
Spike is particularly disapproving of cats.
Spike is a softie when it comes to mice.
In his debut appearance, Dog Trouble, Spike goes after both Tom and Jerry.
Spike has a son named Tyke.
In the shorts, Jerry would often try to get Tom in trouble with Spike.
Spike makes Tom a shoo-in for a beating from the bulldog.
Spike has a few weaknesses that Tom tries to capitalize upon.
Spike's first weakness is his possessiveness about his bone.
Spike's second weakness is his ticklishness.
Spike made his first appearance in the 1942 Tom and Jerry cartoon Dog Trouble.
Spike's first speaking role was in 1944's The Bodyguard.
Billy Bletcher voiced Spike in The Bodyguard and continued until 1949.
From 1949, Daws Butler voiced Spike.
Tyke, unlike his father Spike, does not speak.
Tyke only communicates by yapping, whimpering, growling, facial expressions, and wagging his tail.
In Tom and Jerry Kids, Tyke has a speaking role.
Tom and Jerry Kids is the first time viewers were able to hear Tyke speak.
Spike is very protective towards his son Tyke.
Spike gets very angry at Tom if Tyke is bothered or harmed.
Although Tyke has spoken in Tom and Jerry Kids, Tyke has laughed in one Tom and Jerry short.
Maurice LaMarche performed Spike's voice after Daws Butler.
Frank Welker performed Spike's voice after Daws Butler.
John DiMaggio performed Spike's voice after Daws Butler.
Michael Donovan performed Spike's voice after Daws Butler.
Phil LaMarr performed Spike's voice after Daws Butler.
Rick Zieff currently performs Spike's voice.
Frank Welker provides Tyke's vocal effects.
Patric Zimmerman provides Tyke's speaking roles.

The official music video for the song was produced by Steve Lamar.
The video was filmed along the Californian coast.

The music video features P.R. Brown and his duet partner Lauren Alaina singing along the coast.

Nigeria is the largest oil and gas producer in Africa.
Crude oil from the delta basin comes in two types: light and comparatively heavy.
The lighter crude oil from the delta basin is around 36 gravity.
The heavier crude oil from the delta basin is 20 to 25 gravity.
Both types of crude oil from the delta basin are paraffinic.
Both types of crude oil from the delta basin are low in sulfur.
Barbara Eden plays Stella Johnson.
Stella Johnson is a widowed cosmetics salesperson.
Stella Johnson has a young daughter.
Stella Johnson's joie de vivre angers most of the powerful people in town.
Stella Johnson's joie de vivre angers most of the powerful people on the Parent Teachers Association board.
Stella Johnson's principles anger most of the powerful people in town.
Stella Johnson's principles anger most of the powerful people on the Parent Teachers Association board.
Stella Johnson's individuality angers most of the powerful people in town.
Stella Johnson's individuality angers most of the powerful people on the Parent Teachers Association board.
Stella Johnson inevitably becomes PTA president.
Stella Johnson becomes PTA president after embarrassing Flora.
Flora is the snobby former President of the PTA.
Stella Johnson embarrasses Flora and Flora's equally snobby friends.
Ronny Cox plays Willis 'Will' Newton.
Will Newton is a wealthy member of the PTA.
Will Newton does not agree with Flora and her snobby allies.
Will Newton is in love with Stella Johnson.
Will Newton and Stella Johnson get married at the end of the movie.
Nanette Fabray plays Alice Finley.
Alice Finley is Stella Johnson's best friend.
Alice Finley is Stella Johnson's co-conspirator against the snobs of Harper Valley.
Alice Finley owns and operates the La Moderne Beauty Shop.
Louis Nye plays Kirby Baker.
Kirby Baker is a local real estate agent.
Kirby Baker is allied with Flora and her friends.
Kirby Baker is notorious for being a lecherous playboy.
Kirby Baker is infamous for impregnating his secretaries.
Gladys Wilmot is one of Kirby Baker's secretaries.
Gladys Wilmot left town to see an abortionist in Cincinnati.
As part of a plan to discredit Stella Johnson, Kirby Baker tries to foreclose on Stella Johnson's house.
Kirby Baker's attempt to foreclose on Stella Johnson's house infuriates Stella Johnson.
Kirby Baker gets arrested and jailed for attacking Myrna Wong.
Myrna Wong is a friend of Stella Johnson.
Myrna Wong rebuffs Kirby Baker's advances.
Myrna Wong throws Kirby Baker by use of martial arts.
Myrna Wong destroys Kirby Baker's office.
John Fiedler plays Bobby Taylor.
Bobby Taylor is a man on the PTA.
Bobby Taylor lusts after Stella Johnson.
Bobby Taylor is overly dominated by his wife, Holly Taylor.
Bobby Taylor is open to allowing Stella Johnson to speak.
Bobby Taylor is not above having a fellow PTA board member kidnapped to commit election fraud.
Bobby Taylor was arrested for indecent exposure after being set up by Stella Johnson.
Ron Masak plays Herbie Maddox.
Herbie Maddox is the head bartender at Kelly's bar.
Herbie Maddox is Stella Johnson's ally against Flora and her friends.
Herbie Maddox has a crush on Stella Johnson.
Herbie Maddox is one of Stella Johnson's friends.
Clint Howard plays Corley.
Corley is a young delivery person.
Corley works for the local florist shop.
Corley brings Stella Johnson flowers from Will Newton.
Susan Swift plays Dee Johnson.
Dee Johnson is Stella Johnson's 14-year-old daughter.
Dee Johnson is threatened with expulsion from school if her mother does not conform to the way the PTA wants her to behave.
Dee Johnson has a hand in assisting her mother Stella Johnson and Alice Finley with one of their revenge schemes.
Dee Johnson loses her braces.
Dee Johnson gets a makeover.
Dee Johnson ends up with a boyfriend, Carlyle.
Pat Paulsen plays Otis Harper.
Otis Harper is the descendant of the founding family of Harper Valley.
Otis Harper is a PTA member who is allied with Flora and her friends.
Otis Harper has a tendency to drink all the time.
Otis Harper's drinking annoys his wife, Bertha Harper.
A stampede of elephants, painted pink, stormed through Otis Harper's house.
The stampede of pink elephants destroyed Otis Harper's house.
Amzie Strickland plays Shirley Thompson.
Shirley Thompson is a member of the PTA board.
Shirley Thompson tends to drink a lot of gin.
Shirley Thompson is allied with Flora and her friends.
Shirley Thompson is one of four PTA members spared any retribution from Stella Johnson.
The other three PTA members spared any retribution from Stella Johnson are Will, Skeeter, and Holly Taylor.
Shirley Thompson was seen as the most sympathetic member of the PTA board.
Shirley Thompson tended to be more manipulated than manipulative.
It was never revealed whether Shirley Thompson retained her seat on the PTA.
It is presumed that Shirley Thompson became more sympathetic towards Stella Johnson.
Shirley Thompson was seen waving goodbye at Olive as Olive was being arrested.
Bob Hastings plays Skeeter Duggan.
Skeeter Duggan is a member of the PTA board.
Skeeter Duggan is the town's Notary public.
Skeeter Duggan is sympathetic to Stella Johnson.
Skeeter Duggan is kidnapped by Dutch and Tex at Flora Simpson-Reilly's orders.
Audrey Christie plays Flora Simpson-Reilly.
Flora Simpson-Reilly is the movie's main antagonist.
Flora Simpson-Reilly is the pompous and extremely snobbish president of the PTA board.
Flora Simpson-Reilly thoroughly despises Stella Johnson.
Flora Simpson-Reilly despises all that Stella Johnson stands for.
Stella Johnson defeats Flora Simpson-Reilly for president at the end of the movie.
Flora Simpson-Reilly is desperate to retain her power and prestige in the community.
Flora Simpson-Reilly has Skeeter Duggan, a fellow PTA member, kidnapped so that she and her allies can commit election fraud.
Flora Simpson-Reilly is embarrassed when her permanent set is destroyed by a hair depilatory at the beauty salon.
Molly Dodd plays Olive Glover.
Olive Glover is the recording secretary of the PTA.
Olive Glover is a gambling addict.
Olive Glover is clearly the most corrupt member of the PTA board.
Olive Glover is clearly the most vindictive member of the PTA board.
Olive Glover has a load of hay and horse manure dumped on top of her.
Olive Glover is eventually arrested for embezzlement, after the hay and manure are dumped on her.
Olive Glover initially angers Stella Johnson by sending her a letter denouncing her.
Olive Glover tries to get Mavis arrested for embezzlement.
Mavis is Dee Johnson's friend.
Fay DeWitt plays Willamae Jones.
Willamae Jones is a snide biology teacher at the junior high school.
Willamae Jones is also a member of the PTA.
Willamae Jones makes no secret that she favors the Reilly twins.
Willamae Jones favors the Reilly twins due to the connections between her and Flora.
Willamae Jones is notorious for being a nymphomaniac.
Willamae Jones hides her nymphomania under a prim-and-proper facade.
Willamae Jones is caught in flagrante delicto with Barney Crunk on film.
Barney Crunk is the town's mailman.
DeVera Marcus plays Holly Taylor.
Holly Taylor is Bobby Taylor's obviously overbearing wife.
Holly Taylor tends to drink a lot when Bobby Taylor is out of town.
Holly Taylor does not approve of Bobby Taylor's lusting.
Holly Taylor does not approve of anything else Bobby Taylor does.
The Holly Taylor character in the movie is different from the character in the song.
The character in the song 'seems to use a lot of ice whenever (her husband)'s away', implying adultery with the iceman.
Holly Taylor has ties to Flora and her scheming friends.
Holly Taylor, like Shirley Thompson, is spared any retribution from Stella Johnson.
Holly Taylor is spared retribution because Stella Johnson refuses to date Bobby Taylor.
Louise Foley plays Mavis.
Mavis is Dee Johnson's best friend.
Mavis is nearly framed for a crime she did not commit by Olive Glover.
Olive Glover is vindictive.
Brian Cook plays Carlyle.
Carlyle is a popular track star.
Carlyle chooses Dee Johnson after she gets a makeover.
Carlyle's choice of Dee Johnson angers Bettina Reilly.
Laura Teige plays Bettina Reilly.
Bettina Reilly is one of Flora's twin granddaughters.
Bettina Reilly wants to be with Carlyle.
Bettina Reilly is jealous when Carlyle chooses Dee over her.
Bettina Reilly tends to be as snotty as her grandmother, Flora.
Jan Teige plays Edwina Reilly.
Edwina Reilly is Bettina Reilly's twin sister.
Edwina Reilly is just as snotty as Bettina Reilly.
Irene Yah-Ling Sun plays Myrna Wong.
Myrna Wong is a friend of Stella Johnson.
Myrna Wong is a judo expert.
Myrna Wong is assaulted by Kirby Baker.
Myrna Wong led Kirby Baker on before he assaulted her.
Myrna Wong destroys Kirby Baker and his office in retaliation.
Myrna Wong has Kirby Baker sent to jail for assault.
Tobias Anderson plays Barney Crunk, nicknamed 'Cranky'.
Barney Crunk is the town's nosy mailman.
Barney Crunk had the bad habit of peeking in everyone's mail.
Barney Crunk is caught in flagrante delicto on film with Willamae Jones.
Royce D. Applegate plays Dutch.
Dutch is one of two kidnappers.
Dutch abducts Skeeter Duggan at Flora Simpson-Reilly's orders.
J.J. Barry plays Tex.
Tex is the mastermind of the kidnap plot.
The kidnap plot is meant to get Skeeter Duggan out of the way so Flora Simpson-Reilly and her friends could commit election fraud.
Tex is arrested.
Dutch is arrested.
Dutch is Tex's accomplice.
Tex and Dutch rat out Flora and her friends on their scheme.
Pitt Herbert plays Henry Reilly.
Henry Reilly is Flora's overly dominated husband.
Henry Reilly is the grandfather of Edwina and Bettina.
Henry Reilly is wealthy.
Henry Reilly is very weak-willed.
Henry Reilly is known for acquiescing to his wife's schemes.
Arlen Stuart plays Bertha Harper.
Bertha Harper is the wife of Otis Harper.
Bertha Harper gets annoyed by Otis Harper's continual drinking.
Bertha Harper is terrified when her house is destroyed by pink-painted elephants.

Ibn Battuta's description of pearl diving involved attaching a cord to the diver's waist.

Kylo Ren is a fictional character in the Star Wars franchise.
Kylo Ren was introduced in the 2015 film Star Wars: The Force Awakens.
Adam Driver portrays Kylo Ren.
Kylo Ren is the chosen name of Ben Solo.
Ben Solo is the son of Han Solo and Leia Organa.
Han Solo and Leia Organa are original Star Wars trilogy characters.
Kylo Ren was trained as a Jedi by his uncle Luke Skywalker.
Kylo Ren has been seduced to the dark side of the Force by Supreme Leader Snoke.
Kylo Ren aspires to be as powerful as his grandfather, Darth Vader.
Kylo Ren is the master of the Knights of Ren.
Kylo Ren is a commander of the First Order.
Kylo Ren is later the supreme leader of the First Order.
The First Order is an organization spawned from the fallen Galactic Empire.
Kylo Ren is featured in The Force Awakens media and merchandising.
Kylo Ren appears in the film's sequel, Star Wars: The Last Jedi (2017).
Abrams told Empire in August 2015 that Kylo Ren is not a Sith.
Abrams told Empire that Kylo Ren works under Supreme Leader Snoke.
Abrams told Empire that Supreme Leader Snoke is a powerful figure on the Dark Side of the Force.
Abrams had previously told Entertainment Weekly that the character came to the name Kylo Ren when he joined a group called the Knights of Ren.

Abrams noted that the lightsaber is as dangerous, fierce, and ragged as the character.
The Telegraph explains that Kylo Ren's wild and erratic temper makes him dangerous.
The Telegraph explains that Kylo Ren's angsty instability makes him dangerous.

Melissa Leon cites Kylo Ren's ability to stop a blaster shot mid-air.
Melissa Leon cites Kylo Ren's ability to immobilize victims.

OPEC's headquarters are in Vienna, Austria.
OPEC's official language is English.
OPEC is an international cartel.
OPEC had 14 member states as of May 2017.
OPEC's member states are Algeria, Angola, Ecuador, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Libya, Nigeria, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Venezuela.
Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela are founding members of OPEC.
OPEC's Secretary General is Mohammed Barkindo.
OPEC was established in Baghdad, Iraq.
OPEC's statute is dated September 1960.
OPEC's statute came into effect in January 1961.
OPEC's currency is indexed as USD per barrel (US$/bbl).
OPEC's website is OPEC.org.
OPEC is also called OPEP in several other languages.
OPEC is pronounced OH-pek.
OPEC is an intergovernmental organization of 14 nations as of February 2018.
OPEC was founded in 1960 in Baghdad.
OPEC was founded by the first five members: Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela.
OPEC has been headquartered in Vienna, Austria since 1965.
As of 2016, OPEC's 14 countries accounted for an estimated 44 percent of global oil production.
As of 2016, OPEC's 14 countries held an estimated 73 percent of the world's 'proven' oil reserves.
OPEC has a major influence on global oil prices.
Global oil prices were previously determined by American-dominated multinational oil companies.

Algeria is in North Africa, joined OPEC in 1969, has a population of 40,606,052, an area of 2,381,740 km, oil production of 1,348,361 bbl/day in 2016, and proven reserves of 12,200,000,000 bbl in 2016.

Angola is in Southern Africa, joined OPEC in 2007, has a population of 28,813,463, an area of 1,246,700 km, oil production of 1,769,615 bbl/day in 2016, and proven reserves of 8,423,000,000 bbl in 2016.

Ecuador is in South America, was a member in 1973 to 1992 and rejoined in 2007, has a population of 16,385,068, an area of 283,560 km, oil production of 548,421 bbl/day in 2016, and proven reserves of 8,273,000,000 bbl in 2016.

Equatorial Guinea is in Central Africa, joined OPEC in 2017, has a population of 1,221,490, an area of 28,051 km, oil production of 227,000 bbl/day in 2016, and proven reserves of 1,100,000,000 bbl in 2016.

Iran is in the Middle East, joined OPEC in 1960, has a population of 80,277,428, an area of 1,648,000 km, oil production of 3,990,956 bbl/day in 2016, and proven reserves of 157,530,000,000 bbl in 2016.

Iraq is in the Middle East, joined OPEC in 1960, has a population of 37,202,572, an area of 437,072 km, oil production of 4,451,516 bbl/day in 2016, and proven reserves of 143,069,000,000 bbl in 2016.
